name: Kara's Garden
source:
A cute short visual novel with point and click elements. 

You just moved into a new neighborhood and saw your neighbor Kara tending to her flowers. She then invited you over to her garden and home. 

[From [url=https://foppydoodles.itch.io/karas-garden]itch.io[/url]]
